**Why is C-1088 High?** The claim scored 22.2, which is in the High band. The action is to assign an investigator. Most of the score comes from the bodily injury (BI) category at 59.6 and the network link (NL) category at 36.4. The other categories scored 0.

**Rules that fired:**

- **BI-2 Medical build-up:** The adjuster file (C-1088-adjuster_file, page 1) says visits rose to nearly daily. It says the care is well beyond what is usual for a strain. Confidence is Medium.
- **BI-3 Mostly subjective findings:** The medical records (C-1088-medical_records, page 2) say imaging was unremarkable and exams were normal. They say nearly all findings rest on the patient's own description. Confidence is High.
- **BI-5 Attorney before first treatment:** The attorney was retained on 2024-12-16. The first visit was on 2024-12-23.
- **BI-6 Heavy early treatment:** The loss date was 2024-12-15. There were 15 visits in the first 30 days.
- **NL-3 Same clinic and same attorney:** There is a possible link to 10 other claims. All share Harrington Physical Therapy and David Richardson. They include C-1085, C-1123 and C-1297.
- **NL-6 Large linked cluster:** The claim sits in a group of 12 linked claims.

**Coverage:** Coverage is 90.1%. Three rules could not be checked: AS-6, CT-7 and NL-5. A rule that could not run counts as not fired. The score may therefore be too low.

**Conclusion:** These are unusual patterns and possible links. The score is not a finding of fraud. The claim needs human review.
